register.labelZh: SLEEP 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: sleep on something 可以表示你需要先睡一晚、仔細考慮,然後才作答。；sleep out 表示在戶外過夜;sleep over 則表示在別人家留宿。；sleep through something 表示某人在事情發生期間沒有醒來;sleep in 則表示某人比平日遲起床。；sleep something off 可以描述透過睡眠,讓頭痛、宿醉、時差反應或藥物影響逐漸消退。
register.summaryEn: Sleep on something lets you say that you need a night to think carefully before answering. Sleep out describes spending the night outdoors, while sleep over describes staying at another person’s home. Sleep through something shows that a person did not wake during an event. Sleep in shows that a person woke later than usual. Sleep something off can describe sleeping until a headache, hangover, jet lag or the effects of medicine become weaker.
